card.name: Digits inside kidney-function formulas
card.fires_on: A digit partway through a number in a creatinine clearance or eGFR formula, such as the 0 in 140, the 2 in 72, or the 7 in 1.73.

modes.label: Cockcroft-Gault constants
modes.description: The last digit of 140 or 72 in the creatinine clearance equation.

modes.label: Body surface area and eGFR numbers
modes.description: A digit inside 1.73 m2 or in eGFR equation constants such as 175 and 1.212.

card.plain: It fires on the digits of the fixed numbers used in kidney-function formulas, such as 140, 72 and 1.73.
